intro.name: Hayk
intro.after: , a design engineer who takes products from zero to one for startups, from the brand to the shipped app. I design the moments where a product asks people for something (money, data, attention), and I care about doing it without breaking their trust. At mymizu I’m designing in-app donations for a free app with 500K+ downloads.
intro.note: Yes, you read it as hike, and after the above I know you will never forget my name.

more.text: I studied computational sciences and the arts at Minerva across SF, Tokyo, Berlin, Seoul, Buenos Aires and Taipei, bringing a multidisciplinary, global read on the patterns that shape good products.
